title: Florante at Laura
summary: Florante at Laura is a Tagalog verse romance (awit) by Francisco Balagtas, regarded as his masterpiece. It is traditionally dated to 1838, though a National Library of the Philippines survey gives circa 1838-1861. Scholars read its handling of mortality as a new conception of time in Philippine literature.

uncertainty.note: PMLA (Cambridge) calls it an 1838 poem; the National Library of the Philippines gives circa 1838-1861, so the date of composition or first printing may be later than 1838.

where.modern_name: Balagtas, Bulacan, Philippines (proxy pin: the author's birthplace area; the opened pages do not give the place of writing or first printing)
where.historical_name: Bigaa, Bulacan, Spanish Philippines (the poet's birthplace)

importance.justification: A cornerstone of Tagalog literature by the poet whose name the Bulacan town now bears.
